_comment: Fabric inputs of ADC_CORE that the ADC primitive does not expose and that Radiant ties to a constant. A design must drive them the same way: left unconnected, a CIB input reads 1, and the ADC then converts at mid-scale.
_evidence: Radiant's backannotated netlist ties both to GND_net (one constant LUT output) in all 24 designs of timing/fuzzers/LFCPNX/15-adc-pins; there both wires carry that one net and no other ADC input. Which of the two wires is RSVDH and which RSVDL cannot be told apart in Radiant's designs (same net); the assignment follows LIFCL's ADC tile type. Confirmed on a Versa board: tying both wires low gives Radiant's readings.
